audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the countermodel hypothesis from truth of A at w to falsity of A at w.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The stated contrapositive assumes every premise and the conclusion are true, which is not a countermodel and does not show that the initial signed assumptions are satisfiable.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எதிர்மாதிரியில்~$!A$ ஆனது~$w$ இல் பொய்யாகிறது என்று கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining truth of A; changing the initial signed assumption from F A to T A.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A countermodel to B1,...,Bn entails A makes every Bi true and A false at the same world, exactly satisfying the tableau assumptions T Bi and F A.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the contrapositive now assume all premises true and the conclusion false at w?

audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing every later occurrence and the premise to A; retaining an unexplained formula switch.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The false-box expansion preserves the operand B and introduces only a new successor prefix.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does every formula in the false-box case retain operand B?

audited_source_corrections.action: Restored prefix sigma on the false-disjunction premise in the prefixed-tableau soundness proof.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Every premise and conclusion in the proof is prefixed, but this one false-disjunction premise alone omits [sigma].
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பொய்யான பிரிப்பின் எடுகோளில்~$[\sigma]$ முன்னொட்டை மீட்டுள்ளது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving an unprefixed signed formula in a set explicitly defined to contain prefixed formulas.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The rule preserves one world prefix across the premise and its two conclusions.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the false-disjunction premise now carry the same sigma prefix used by its rule?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the final conclusion of the entailment-soundness corollary from Gamma proves A to Gamma entails A.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof begins by assuming derivability, supposes semantic entailment fails, and derives a contradiction, but then merely repeats the original derivability assumption.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முரண்பாட்டிலிருந்து வேண்டிய~$\Gamma \Entails !A$ என்ற முடிவையே எடுக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Repeating the already assumed syntactic statement; changing the corollary itself.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Negating non-entailment yields entailment, completing the stated soundness corollary.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the final sentence now conclude the semantic claim established by contradiction?
